notes.title: Furr Grinder 185 Upgrade Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
YOU WILL NEED TO DELETE SAVED GAME DATA ON MAIN MENU FOR THIS UPDATE TO TAKE EFFECT!
Furr Grinder 185 Upgrade Bug Fix:
Thanks to a review I tested the game extensively over the past 48 hours, and found that the grinder does indeed break at exactly 185 upgrades. Now at upgrade 185 the cost will be 5 million per upgrade after. This "fixes" the bug by at least giving the player a way to continue upgrading past 185!!!

notes.title: Major Game Nerf | One Trillion Achievement Reduced To 10 Billion
notes.notes:
YOU WILL NEED TO DELETE SAVED GAME DATA ON MAIN MENU FOR UPDATE TO TAKE EFFECT!!!

Major Game Nerf:
Cost multiplier reduced in half, all upgrades cost half as much now.
Furr grinder should now cost 1/3rd as much, or 1/6th with the added global multiplier.

One Trillion Achievement Reduced To 10 Billion:
This was done out of major requests concerning that getting to 1 trillion would take thousands of hours. The achievement has been modified and changed via the new update.
